sentences.text: The petitioner is challenging registration of FIR dated 4.5.2017 and further proceedings pertaining to Crime No.60/2017 for the offence under Sections 420, 376, 504, 506, 328, 494 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Shri Gitesh Singh Thakur, learned Government Advocate for the State submits that the petitioner has been acquitted of the charges on 16.5.2019 and nothing survives for adjudication in this petition.
In view of the aforesaid, this petition is disposed of as having been rendered infructuous.
